proposal.summary: CM550's engine protection (Cummins EPF / EPS) runs nine input channels: 0 coolant level, 1 coolant temperature, 2 intake manifold temperature, 3 oil pressure, 4 water in fuel, 5 boost pressure, 6 engine sync fuel pressure, 7 fuel temperature and 8 ambient air pressure. Each channel has a 36-byte configuration record (0x807032 + 36n, e2m 10B7 / 112B-1132), a 46-byte state record (0x80d0dc + 46n, e2m 10B0 / 114F-1156), a 30-byte history record (0x8057c0 + 30n, e2m 10B2 / 1140-1147) and 5-entry fault logs (e2m 10DA), with enable bits 112 + 4n + k. A scheduler at executive frame 15 runs five tasks in turn: the over-limit durations, the restart severity, the fault derate fuel limit, the engine speed limit with the fault logs, and the shutdown (processDiagnosticLimitStatus). The algorithm is the one CM848 runs on its single fuel temperature channel. Five helpers and the user fueling state chain are step-for-step twins and get shared names; the rest are counterparts that differ in constants (channel 3 vs 4, an extra CRANKING test, the shutdown override), signedness (CM550 compares unsigned) or extra steps. Four listed functions are not engine protection at all: 0x30b04 is an unreferenced empty interrupt handler, 0x3458c selects the user fueling state, 0xc66a calculates the altitude derate fuel limit and 0xd5e6 initializes the vehicle speed and cruise words. The code proves the three tables' layouts field by field, so they are typed as struct arrays (CM848's type names where the layout matches). That absorbs 45 of the 50 listed rows and 410 flat rows in all.

functions.role: Runs one of the five engine protection tasks per call (the index wraps at 5), or sets the no-derate outputs while engine protection is disabled.
functions.discriminator: The only reader and writer of the task index 0x80060e (a switch through the jump table at 0x18646) and the only code that presets the four derate outputs (EPESLM / EPFLLM / EPFLLMSS / EPSQ) while EPEN is clear. It is the one caller of the five task functions.
functions.plate_comment: The engine protection task scheduler, run at executive frame 15 of 40 (jsr at 0x1bb9a in executiveFrameInterruptHandler). With algorithm_enable_flags_2_cal.engine_protection_enable (EPEN) clear it sets the outputs to no derate: engine_speed_limit_fault_derate (EPESLM) = maximum_rated_engine_speed, fault_derate_fuel_limit (EPFLLM) = fuel_demand_maximum, fault_derate_active_flag and engine_protection_shutdown_approaching_flag = 0. Otherwise it runs one task per call by engine_protection_task_index (0-4, then 0 again): countEngineProtectionOverLimitDurations, updateEngineProtectionRestartSeverity, cm550_calculateFaultDerateFuelLimit, cm550_calculateFaultDerateEngineSpeedLimit with logEngineProtectionChannelFaults, and processDiagnosticLimitStatus (the shutdown). CM848's counterpart cm848_runFaultDerateScheduler also sets engine_protection_timer_state, runs the precrank examination every pass and latches the shutdown override in task 1 (was cm550_engineProtectionMultiStateSlowCycle40Coordinator).
functions.evidence: 0x18628 move.w 0x803c98 / andi.w #0x10 (EPEN). Clear: 0x1868a-0x186a4 move.w 0x803f40 -> 0x80d288, 0x808004 -> 0x80d284, clr.w 0x80d286 / 0x80d28e. Set: 0x18636 move.w (a2 = 0x80060e) / cmp.l #4 / bhi, then jmp through the word table at 0x18646 (000a 0012 001a 0022 0030 -> 0x18650 jsr 0x18a26, 0x18658 jsr 0x18cb6, 0x18660 jsr 0x19702, 0x18668 jsr 0x18e0c + jsr 0x1952c, 0x18676 jsr 0x18fcc); 0x1867c addq.w #1 / cmpi.w #5 / clr.w. Only caller: jsr at 0x1bb9a (frame 15 of executiveFrameInterruptHandler; move.w #0x10 follows). CM848 0x507c44 differs: engine_protection_timer_state = 3 in the disabled branch, a cm848_examineEngineProtectionBeforeCranking call on every enabled pass, and cm848_latchEngineProtectionShutdownOverride in task 1. Name unique in both function_renames.csv.

functions.role: Returns a channel's fueling or engine speed severity index after one ramp step up or down.
functions.discriminator: The only helper that steps the history severity index (+0 / +2) by the configuration ramp rate (+6 / +8), up (capped at 0x100) while the over-limit duration (state +6 / +8) is past the derate start duration (+2 / +4), else down (floored at 0). cm550_interpolateEngineProtectionSeverity places the input between thresholds instead.
functions.plate_comment: Returns the channel's fueling (is_engine_speed 0) or engine speed (1) severity index after one ramp step: the history index plus the configuration ramp rate (EP??FLIC / RPIC, +6 / +8), capped at 0x100, while the state's over-limit duration (+6 / +8) is above the derate start duration (EP??FLDD / RPDD, +2 / +4); otherwise the index minus the ramp rate, floored at 0. Called by cm550_calculateFaultDerateFuelLimit (0) and cm550_calculateFaultDerateEngineSpeedLimit (1). The twin of CM848 0x507d50: one shared name (was cm550_protectionThresholdCalculationHelper / cm848_rampEngineProtectionSeverityIndex).
functions.evidence: CM550 0x186b2-0x18706: a2 = configuration (0x10,a7), a0 = state (0x14,a7), a1 = history (0x18,a7); tst.w (0x1c,a7) picks (history+0, state+6, config+2, config+6) or (history+2, state+8, config+4, config+8); cmp.w d1,d0 / bls; above: add.w d3,d2 / cmpi.w #0x100 / bls cap; else cmp.w d3,d2 / bls -> sub.w d3,d2 or clr.w d2; move.w d2,d0. CM848 0x507d50: the same loads (lhz 0(r5), 6(r4), 2(r3) or 2(r5), 8(r4), 4(r3); rate lhzx at 6 / 8), cmpw r6,r4 / ble, add / clrlwi 16 / cmpwi 256 cap, else cmpw / subf or li 0. lhz zero-extends, so the signed 32-bit cmpw is the same unsigned 16-bit compare as CM550's bls. Same constants and the same callers: CM550 jsr 0x19790 (fuel limit, selector 0) and 0x18e94 (engine speed limit, 1); CM848 cm848_calculateFaultDerateFuelLimit / cm848_calculateFaultDerateEngineSpeedLimit. CM848's function_definitions rows for 0x507d50 must take the new name.

functions.discriminator: The only engine protection helper that divides (divs.l): it maps the input linearly between two thresholds, while the ramp helper steps.
functions.plate_comment: Returns the input's place between a minimum and a maximum threshold as a severity: (input - minimum) << 8 / (maximum - minimum) with sign-extended 16-bit differences, clamped to 0..0x100. Called by updateEngineProtectionRestartSeverityIndexes and cm550_calculateFaultDerateFuelLimit with the words the state's input, minimum and maximum threshold pointers point to. CM848's counterpart returns 0 when the input equals the minimum and divides through cm848_clampedDivisionWithBounds (was cm550_protectionPercentageCalculator).
functions.evidence: 0x1870a-0x1873c: d2 = minimum (0xa,a7); d0 = input (0x8,a7) - d2, ext.l, lsl.l #8; d1 = maximum (0xc,a7) - d2, ext.l; divs.l d1,d0; cmpi.w #0x100 / ble else 0x100; tst.w / bge else 0. Callers: jsr 0x18c74 (pushes *(state+0xe), *(state+0xa), *input) and jsr 0x197b8. CM848 0x507dc0: if input == minimum return 0, else cm848_clampedDivisionWithBounds((input - minimum) << 8, maximum - minimum, 0x100, 0). The steps differ (an extra test and a division helper), so this is a counterpart.

functions.role: Start-up initializer of engine protection: points the nine channel state records at their inputs, thresholds and fault logs, then resets the derate and shutdown bookkeeping.
functions.discriminator: The only writer of the state records' pointer fields (input +0, mask +4, thresholds +0xa / +0xe / +0x12, fault logs +0x26 / +0x2a). It calls initializeFaultDerateEngineSpeedLimit, cm550_initializeShutdownLimitVariables and cm550_initializeEngineProtectionShutdownCounting, once, from mc68k_applicationMain.
functions.plate_comment: Start-up initializer of engine protection (one call from mc68k_applicationMain at 0x28732). It fills the nine records of engine_protection_channel_state_table: the input pointers (EP??SA: the coolant level switch 0x8091e6 with mask 1, the filtered_value of the coolant temperature / oil pressure / water in fuel / boost pressure / fuel pressure / ambient air pressure sensor records, engine_protection_intake_manifold_temperature and engine_protection_fuel_temperature), the threshold pointers into each channel's configuration record (for oil pressure the speed-dependent limits 0x80dabe / 0x80dac0) and the fault log pointers (e2m 10DA). It then calls initializeFaultDerateEngineSpeedLimit, cm550_initializeShutdownLimitVariables and cm550_initializeEngineProtectionShutdownCounting and clears engine_protection_task_index. CM848's counterpart hpcr_initializeEngineProtection sets up its single fuel temperature channel and runs more resets (was vp44_engineProtectionSystemInit; nothing here touches the VP44 pump).
functions.evidence: 0x18742-0x1895c: a4 = 0x80a2aa (the A/D sensor_state_t records, 22 bytes each), a5 = 0x8055b2, a2 = 0x80d0dc stepping moveq #46, a3 = 0x807032 stepping moveq #36. Per channel it stores the input (0x8091e6; a4+0x8c = coolant_temperature_sensor_state.filtered_value; 0x80a26a; a4+0x60 oil pressure; a4+0x1c0 water in fuel; a4+0x76 boost; a4+0x4a fuel pressure; 0x80a254; a4+0x110 ambient air pressure), the pointers a3+10 / a3+12 / a3+14 into +0xa / +0xe / +0x12 (oil pressure 0x80dabe / 0x80dac0) and the logs into +0x26 / +0x2a (0x805562; 0x80558a x2; 0x8055b2 x2; 0x8055da / 0x805602; 0x80562a / 0x805656; 0x80567e / 0x8056a6; 0x8056ce / 0x8056f6; 0x80571e / 0x805746; 0x80576e / 0x805796). Then jsr 0x18f4c, 0x19960 and 0x192e0, and clr.w 0x80060e. Only caller: jsr at 0x28732. CM848 0x507e20 sets one channel, picks the engine speed log by configuration flag 0x1000, and calls cm848_resetFaultDerateFuelLimit, cm848_resetEngineProtectionShutdownState and the override and precrank resets.

functions.role: Returns 1 when a channel's input is past the threshold picked by its fueling or engine speed side and the threshold select, or when a switch channel's bit is in its active state.
functions.discriminator: The only function that compares the input with the threshold pointers and the shutdown thresholds (+0x10 / +0x12 / +0x20 / +0x22). Every other engine protection helper calls it (8 call sites).
functions.plate_comment: Returns 1 when the channel's input is past the threshold picked by is_engine_speed and threshold_select. Select 0 is the word at the state's minimum threshold pointer (fueling) or engine speed lower limit pointer, 2 the shutdown duration threshold (configuration +0x10 / +0x12) and 3 the shutdown severity threshold (+0x20 / +0x22). Configuration flag 0x4 means at or above, else below, with unsigned compares. A switch channel (flags 0x30) is past when ((input & input_mask) != 0) equals (flag 0x10 != 0). CM848's counterpart compares signed, has select 1 (the maximum threshold) and an unwired switch case (was cm550_protectionConditionEvaluator).
functions.evidence: 0x18978-0x189ae: d4 = flags; andi.w #0x30 -> move.w (a0) / and.w (0x4,a2) / sne vs (flags & 0x10) sne, cmp.l -> 1 or 0. 0x189b0-0x189fa: d5 = *input; tst.w (0x20,a7) (is_engine_speed). With 0: d2 = (0x22,a7) select 0 -> *(0xa,a2), 2 -> (0x10,a1), 3 -> (0x20,a1). With 1: 0 -> *(0x12,a2), 2 -> (0x12,a1), 3 -> (0x22,a1). Select 1 has no case. 0x18a00-0x18a24: flags & 4 -> cmp.w d3,d5 / bcs = 0 (so >= gives 1), else bcc = 0 (so < gives 1); both are unsigned. Callers: 0x18a58, 0x18a88, 0x18bd4, 0x18bfe, 0x18c3e, 0x18c92, 0x19104, 0x191b2. CM848 0x507ebc loads the thresholds with lha and compares signed (cmpw), takes select 1 as the maximum threshold pointer, and special-cases one switch configuration. The code differs, so this is a counterpart.

functions.role: Per channel, counts the fueling and engine speed over-limit durations while the input is past its thresholds.
functions.discriminator: The only writer of the state's fueling_duration (+6) and engine_speed_duration (+8): saturating counts, reset to 0, gated by errors_allowed (+0x16) and the configuration flags 0x101 / 0x402. It is task 0 of the scheduler.
functions.plate_comment: Task 0 of cm550_runEngineProtectionScheduler. For each of the nine channels while errors_allowed (EP??EREN, state +0x16) is set: with configuration flags 0x101 it counts fueling_duration (EP??FLTM, +6) up by one (saturating at 0xffff) while cm550_isEngineProtectionInputPastThreshold(configuration, state, 0, 0) is 1, else sets it to 0; with flags 0x402 it does the same for engine_speed_duration (EP??RPTM, +8) with (1, 0). While errors are not allowed both durations are 0. The twin of CM848 0x50802c: one shared name (was protectionState0FaultDurationCounter / cm848_countEngineProtectionOverLimitDurations).
functions.evidence: CM550 0x18a2a-0x18ac2: a3 = 0x807032 (+36), a2 = 0x80d0dc (+46), end a4 = 0x807032 + 0x144; the loop tests the bound first (bra 0x18ab8). tst.w (0x16,a2), else clr.w +6 / +8; andi.w #0x101 -> bsr 0x18968 (c, s, 0, 0) -> clr.w (0x6,a2) or cmpi.w #0xffff / addq.w #1; andi.w #0x402 -> (1, 0) on (0x8,a2). CM848 0x50802c: cmplw / ble loop guard first; lhz 22(r30) beq -> clear both; andi. 257 -> bl 0x507ebc (0, 0) -> 0 or cmplwi 65535 / addi 1 -> sth 6(r30); andi. 1026 -> bl (1, 0) -> 8(r30). The steps, their order and the constants are the same; only the state stride (46 / 62) and the table end differ, both layout. Both are task 0 of the scheduler (CM550 jsr at 0x18650). CM848 has no twin of the old unprefixed name. Shared name unique in both.

functions.role: At start-up, re-checks the channel that caused the last shutdown and, when its input is still past its threshold, sets its precrank error and the precrank shutdown command.
functions.discriminator: The only writer of the state's precrank_error (+0x18) and of engine_protection_precrank_shutdown_command_flag (0x80d28a, e2m EPPKSO). It runs once, from mc68k_applicationMain right after cm550_initializeEngineProtection, for the recorded shutdown channel only (not 255, not 3).
functions.plate_comment: The engine protection restart examination before cranking (e2m 10B1 +10 EPPKSO 'EPF shutdown engine command from restart examine before cranking'), run once at start-up (jsr at 0x28738 in mc68k_applicationMain, right after cm550_initializeEngineProtection). It acts when engine protection, its shutdown and its restart are enabled (EPEN / EPSOEN / EPRYEN), a shutdown channel is recorded (engine_protection_active_fault_index, EPSOAE, not 255 and not 3 = oil pressure), and the consecutive shutdown count (EPSOCU) is at or above max_number_of_shutdowns_before_restart_is_not_allowed (EPSOMXLM). If that channel's shutdown and restart bits (112 + 4n + 2 / + 3) are set and its input is still past the fueling (configuration flag 0x1) or engine speed (0x2) threshold, it sets the channel's precrank_error (EP??PKER) and engine_protection_precrank_shutdown_command_flag; processDiagnosticLimitStatus turns that into the shutdown command. CM848's counterpart runs every scheduler pass while CRANKING and exempts channel 4 (was cm550_diagnosticProtectionEvaluator).
functions.evidence: 0x18ace-0x18afa: andi.l #0x10 / #0x1 / #0x20 of 0x803c98; 0x18afe / 0x18b0a: cmpi.w #0xff / #3 of 0x8058ce; 0x18b16: 0x8058d0 vs 0x807f3c (bcs out). Configuration = 0x807032 + 36 x channel (0x18b26-0x18b3e), state = 0x80d0dc + 46 x channel (0x18b40-0x18b5a). Bit = channel x 4 + 0x70; bits +2 and +3 are tested in the table at 0x803c94 (0x18b68-0x18bc0). flags & 1 -> jsr 0x18968 (c, s, 0, 0) -> move.w #1,(0x18,a2) and (a4) = 0x80d28a (a4 set at 0x18ac8); flags & 2 -> (c, s, 1, 0), the same stores. Only caller: jsr at 0x28738. CM848 0x508130 also requires engine_state == CRANKING, runs every scheduler pass, exempts channel 4 and uses bit base 0x80.

functions.role: Sets a channel's fueling and engine speed restart severity indexes from whether its input is still past its thresholds.
functions.discriminator: The only writer of the history restart severity indexes (+4 / +6) with a value (0, 0x100 or the interpolation); updateEngineProtectionRestartSeverity only clears them for the other channels.
functions.plate_comment: Sets the channel's restart severity indexes in its history record. With configuration flag 0x1 the fueling one (EP??FLRI, +4) is 0 while the input is inside its fueling threshold, else 0x100 with flag 0x40, else cm550_interpolateEngineProtectionSeverity of the input between the minimum and maximum thresholds. With flag 0x2 the engine speed one (EP??RPRI, +6) is 0 or 0x100. Called by updateEngineProtectionRestartSeverity for the recorded shutdown channel. The twin of CM848 0x50832c: one shared name (was cm550_diagnosticProtectionProcessor / cm848_updateEngineProtectionRestartSeverityIndexes).
functions.evidence: CM550 0x18c20-0x18cb4: a4 = configuration (0x18,a7), a3 = state (0x1c,a7), a2 = history (0x20,a7); andi.w #1 -> jsr 0x18968 (c, s, 0, 0) -> 0: clr.w (0x4,a2); andi.w #0x40 -> move.w #0x100,(0x4,a2); else jsr 0x18708 (*input, *(0xa,a3), *(0xe,a3)) -> (0x4,a2). andi.w #2 -> (c, s, 1, 0) -> clr.w or move.w #0x100 (0x6,a2). CM848 0x50832c: clrlwi 31 -> bl 0x507ebc (0, 0) -> li 0, or rlwinm bit 0x40 -> li 256, or bl 0x507dc0 (lha *input, *min, *max) -> sth 4(r28); rlwinm bit 0x2 -> bl (1, 0) -> 0 / 256 -> sth 6(r28). The steps, the order and the constants are the same. Only caller in each firmware: the restart severity loop (CM550 bsr at 0x18d74, CM848 bl at 0x5085b0). CM848's function_definitions rows for 0x50832c must take the new name.

functions.role: Task 1: for the recorded shutdown channel with its shutdown and restart bits set, updates its restart severity indexes and its restart limitation; clears the restart severity indexes of every other channel.
functions.discriminator: The only loop that compares each channel index with the recorded shutdown channel (0x8058ce) and calls updateEngineProtectionRestartSeverityIndexes / cm550_updateEngineProtectionRestartLimitationCommands. Its else branch is the only clear of history +4 / +6.
functions.plate_comment: Task 1 of cm550_runEngineProtectionScheduler. With the engine protection shutdown and restart enabled (EPSOEN / EPRYEN) and a shutdown channel recorded (engine_protection_active_fault_index not 255), it walks the nine channels (configuration, state and history records, enable bit 112 + 4n). The recorded channel, when its shutdown and restart bits (+2 / +3) are set, gets updateEngineProtectionRestartSeverityIndexes and cm550_updateEngineProtectionRestartLimitationCommands. Every other channel has both restart severity indexes cleared. The twin of CM848 0x5084b4: one shared name; only layout constants differ (CM848's enable bits start at 128, its state records are 62 bytes and its table has one channel) (was cm550_protectionState1DiagnosticValidator / cm848_updateEngineProtectionRestartSeverity).
functions.evidence: CM550 0x18cba-0x18dac: andi.l #1 / #0x20 of 0x803c98; cmpi.w #0xff of 0x8058ce; loop a3 = 0x807032 (+36), a4 = 0x80d0dc (+46), a2 = 0x8057c0 (+30), d2 = 112 (+4), d3 = channel (+1), end 0x807176 tested first; channel == 0x8058ce and bits d2+2 / d2+3 of 0x803c94 -> bsr 0x18c1c (c, s, h) and jsr 0x18dae (channel, s, c); else clr.w (0x4,a2) / (0x6,a2). CM848 0x5084b4: clrlwi 31 / rlwinm 0x20 of algorithm word 2; lha active channel == 255 exits; loop r31 configuration (+36), r27 state (+62), r30 history (+30), r29 = 128 (+4), r28 channel (+1), guard first; the same bit +2 / +3 tests; bl 0x50832c (c, s, h) then bl 0x508408 (channel, s, c); else sth 0 at 4 / 6 of the history. The checks, the order, the calls and their arguments are the same. Only layout constants differ: the enable bit base, the state stride and the table end. This is a judgment call; see notes. Only caller: task 1 (CM550 jsr at 0x18658). Shared name unique in both.

functions.role: For channel 3 (oil pressure) after the maximum number of consecutive shutdowns: sets the restart limitation shutdown approaching and shutdown command flags.
functions.discriminator: The only writer of 0x80d27a / 0x80d27c (e2m 10B1 +0 EPRYO2SO / +2 EPRYO2SQ).
functions.plate_comment: The engine protection restart limitation, for channel 3 (oil pressure; the e2m names EPRYO2SO / EPRYO2SQ after it) only. Once engine_protection_consecutive_shutdown_count (EPSOCU) has reached max_number_of_shutdowns_before_restart_is_not_allowed (EPSOMXLM) and the channel's errors_allowed is set, it sets engine_protection_restart_limitation_shutdown_approaching_flag (EPRYO2SQ) to (fueling_duration != 0) and engine_protection_restart_limitation_shutdown_command_flag (EPRYO2SO) to (shutdown_warning_time < fueling_duration, unsigned). Otherwise both keep their values. updateEngineProtectionRestartSeverity calls it for the recorded channel (0x18d7e). CM848's counterpart cm848_checkEngineProtectionRestartLimitation acts on channel 4 and adds the shutdown override path (PR #53 round 96; round 97 confirms the name).
functions.evidence: 0x18db2-0x18e0a: cmpi.w #3,(0xc,a7); 0x8058d0 vs 0x807f3c (bcs out); tst.w (0x16,a2) (errors_allowed, a2 = state (0xe,a7)); tst.w (0x6,a2) -> (a1 = 0x80d27c) = 1 / 0; move.w (0x1e,a0) of the configuration (0x12,a7) / cmp.w (0x6,a2) / bcc -> (a3 = 0x80d27a) = 0, else 1. Only caller: jsr at 0x18d7e. CM848 0x508408: channel 4, plus the override branch (state fueling_duration = 0, engine_protection_shutdown_override_lamp_flag = 1). The round 96 name is right; the plate is refreshed for the new names.

functions.role: Records the shutdown channel at power-up and clears the previous shutdown command.
functions.discriminator: The only writer of engine_protection_power_up_shutdown_channel (0x80061e) and the start-up clear of engine_shutdown_command_flag_previous (0x80061c), the two inputs of the consecutive shutdown count in processDiagnosticLimitStatus.
functions.plate_comment: Start-up step of cm550_initializeEngineProtection (after cm550_initializeShutdownLimitVariables): copies engine_protection_active_fault_index (e2m 10B3 +0 EPSOAE, the channel of the last shutdown) into engine_protection_power_up_shutdown_channel and clears engine_shutdown_command_flag_previous. processDiagnosticLimitStatus counts a new shutdown on the 0 to 1 edge of the command, and adds to the consecutive shutdown count only when the shutting channel equals the one recorded here. CM848's cm848_resetEngineProtectionShutdownState records the same channel among more resets (PR #53 round 96; round 97 confirms the name).
functions.evidence: 0x192e0 move.w (0x8058ce),(0x80061e); 0x192ea clr.w (0x80061c); rts. Only caller: jsr at 0x18956 in cm550_initializeEngineProtection. Users: processDiagnosticLimitStatus 0x19260 tst.w 0x80061c (the edge), 0x19278 cmp.w 0x80061e then addq.w 0x8058d0 or move.w #1. CM848 0x508de8 also clears the approaching / command flags, the latch, the time counts, the override and the timer state. The round 96 name is right.

functions.role: Returns 1 when the input is above (flag 0x4) or below (flag 0x8 with 0x4 clear) a recorded extreme, else 0.
functions.discriminator: The only helper that compares the input with a recorded extreme (the fault log entry +4 or the history input_extremity) rather than with a threshold.
functions.plate_comment: Returns 1 when the input is more extreme than the recorded value: above it with configuration flag 0x4 (the maximum is tracked), below it with 0x4 clear and 0x8 set (the minimum); 0 with neither. Unsigned word compares. Called by cm550_recordEngineProtectionFaultLogEntry (the fault log entry's extreme) and logEngineProtectionChannelFaults (the history's input_extremity). CM848's counterpart compares signed (was cm550_protectionCalculationHelper).
functions.evidence: 0x192f6-0x19330: d1 = input (0xc,a7), d3 = extreme (0xe,a7), d2 = flags (0x10,a7); andi.w #4 -> cmp.w d3,d1 / bls -> 0, else 1; andi.w #8 -> cmp.w d3,d1 / bcc -> 0, else 1. Both are unsigned. Callers: jsr 0x19410 and 0x1969a. CM848 0x508f24 uses cmpw / ble and bge on arguments its callers sign-extend (extsh / lha at 0x509490-0x509494), so it is a signed compare; CM850's matching extremes start at 0x8000 / 0x7fff where CM550's start at 0 / 0xffff. The compare differs, so this is a counterpart.

functions.role: For the current channel's active fueling or engine speed fault: opens the fault log entry the first time, sets the fault bits and tracks the input's extreme.
functions.discriminator: The only code that opens a fault log entry (time, duration 0, extreme preset) and sets the fault bit in both 0x806000 and 0x806040. Its partner cm550_closeEngineProtectionFaultLogEntry clears the bit and closes the entry.
functions.plate_comment: For the current channel (engine_protection_current_configuration / _state / _history, stepped by logEngineProtectionChannelFaults), records an active fueling (is_engine_speed 0) or engine speed (1) fault. The first time (log flag EP??FLFG / RPFG clear) it opens the entry at the log index (EP??FLIN / RPIN) of the channel's fault log: occurrence_time = key_on_hour_meter, duration 0, and the extreme preset to 0xffff (configuration flag 0x8) or 0. Then, with interrupts masked, it sets the fault bit (configuration +0x1a / +0x1c, EP??FLFU / RPFU) in 0x806000 and 0x806040, and with flags 0xc it keeps the input's extreme in the entry. CM848's counterpart presets 0x7fff / 0x8000, sets one fault array and copies the entry into the state (was protectionStateProcessor).

roles.role: Engine protection task dispatcher. executiveFrameInterruptHandler calls it once per 40-frame cycle (jsr at 0x1bb9a), right after cm550_selectEngineProtectionFuelTemperature. While algorithm_enable_flags_2_cal.engine_protection_enable (0x803c98 & 0x10) is set, it runs one task per call through the jump table at 0x18646. The task is chosen by engine_protection_state_phase_index (0x80060e, 0-4, wraps at 5): 0 = 0x18a26 over-limit durations, 1 = 0x18cb6 restart severity, 2 = cm550_calculateFaultDerateFuelLimit (0x19702), 3 = cm550_calculateFaultDerateEngineSpeedLimit then 0x1952c channel fault logging, 4 = processDiagnosticLimitStatus (shutdown). With the enable clear it sets engine_speed_limit_fault_derate (0x80d288) to the maximum rated speed 0x803f40 and fault_derate_fuel_limit (0x80d284) to fuel_demand_maximum, and clears fault_derate_active_flag (0x80d286) and engine_protection_shutdown_approaching_flag (0x80d28e). In that case the index does not advance.
roles.discriminator: The only function that picks among the five engine protection tasks. It reads no channel record.
roles.cm848_counterpart: cm848_runFaultDerateScheduler @ 0x507c44, counterpart. It has the same five tasks in the same order and the same disabled defaults, but CM848 also calls cm848_examineEngineProtectionBeforeCranking on every pass and cm848_latchEngineProtectionShutdownOverride in task 1, and sets engine_protection_timer_state = 3 when disabled.

roles.role: Returns a channel's next derate severity index (0-0x100). Arguments: configuration record, state record, history record, selector. Selector 0 uses the fueling fields (history +0 severity, state +6 over-limit duration, configuration +2 derate start duration, configuration +6 ramp step). Selector 1 uses the engine speed fields (history +2, state +8, configuration +4, configuration +8). While the duration is past the start duration (unsigned compare) it returns severity + step, capped at 0x100. Otherwise it returns severity - step, floored at 0.
roles.discriminator: The only function that ramps a severity index by the configured step. Its siblings test thresholds (0x18968), interpolate (0x18708) or set the restart indexes (0x18c1c). Callers are the two derate loops only: 0x19790 (fuel, selector 0) and 0x18e94 (engine speed, selector 1).
roles.cm848_counterpart: cm848_rampEngineProtectionSeverityIndex @ 0x507d50, twin. The disassembly matches instruction for instruction: argument order, record offsets (history 0/2, state 6/8, configuration 2/4 and 6/8), unsigned compares (lhz + cmpw), cap 0x100, floor 0. The callers are the same too (cm848_calculateFaultDerateFuelLimit with 0, cm848_calculateFaultDerateEngineSpeedLimit with 1). One shared unprefixed name, so both rows change.

roles.role: Interpolates an input between a minimum and a maximum threshold into a severity index: (short)(input - minimum) << 8, divided with divs.l by (short)(maximum - minimum), then clamped to 0..0x100 with signed compares. Nothing guards against maximum == minimum. Two callers: 0x18c1c (fueling restart severity) and the fault derate fuel limit loop at 0x197b8. Both pass *input, *(state +0xA minimum pointer) and *(state +0xE maximum pointer).
roles.discriminator: The only arithmetic interpolation in the family. 0x186ae ramps; 0x18968 and 0x192f2 compare.
roles.cm848_counterpart: cm848_interpolateEngineProtectionSeverity @ 0x507dc0, counterpart. Same formula and the same two callers, but CM848 returns 0 when input == minimum and divides through cm848_clampedDivisionWithBounds(..., 0x100, 0). CM550 divides inline with no guard.

roles.role: Start-up initializer of engine protection, called once from mc68k_applicationMain (0x28732). It fills the nine 46-byte channel state records at 0x80d0dc: input pointer +0, threshold pointers +0xA / +0xE / +0x12 (= the channel configuration's +0xA / +0xC / +0xE), and fault log pointers +0x26 / +0x2A. Channel inputs: 0 = coolant level switch word 0x8091e6 with mask 1 (+4); 1 = coolant_temperature_sensor_state.filtered_value; 2 = 0x80a26a (EPIMTPFT); 3 = oil_pressure_sensor_state.filtered_value, with the speed-dependent oil pressure limits 0x80dabe / 0x80dac0 as thresholds; 4 = water_in_fuel_sensor_state; 5 = boost_pressure_sensor_state; 6 = fuel_pressure_sensor_state (engine sync fuel pressure); 7 = engine_protection_fuel_temperature 0x80a254; 8 = ambient_air_pressure_sensor_state. Fault logs: channel 0 has only a fueling log (0x805562); channels 1 and 2 have one log for both faults (0x80558a, 0x8055b2); channels 3-8 have separate fueling and engine speed logs. It then calls initializeFaultDerateEngineSpeedLimit, 0x19960 (which actually resets the fault derate fuel limit) and 0x192e0, and sets the phase index 0x80060e to 0. The live state records in the extended RAM dump hold exactly these pointers.
roles.discriminator: The only writer of the channel state pointers. Nothing in it touches the VP44 pump or its messages, so the vp44_ prefix is wrong.
roles.cm848_counterpart: hpcr_initializeEngineProtection @ 0x507e20, counterpart. Same job (wire the channel state to its input, thresholds and logs, reset the derate limits, set the task index to 0), but CM848 has one channel (fuel temperature), chooses the engine speed log by configuration flag 0x1000, and also resets the shutdown override detector and the precrank state.

roles.role: Returns 1 when a channel's input is past a threshold, else 0. Arguments: configuration, state, is_engine_speed, threshold_select. For a switch input (configuration flags & 0x30) it returns 1 when ((*input & state mask +4) != 0) equals (flags & 0x10 != 0). For an analog input it compares *input with one threshold: select 0 = the fueling minimum pointer (state +0xA) or the engine speed lower limit pointer (+0x12); select 2 = configuration +0x10 / +0x12; select 3 = configuration +0x20 / +0x22 (shutdown severity thresholds). With flag 0x4 the input is past when input >= threshold, otherwise when input < threshold. All compares are unsigned (bcs/bcc). Callers: 0x18a26, 0x18ac4 and 0x18c1c (select 0), and processDiagnosticLimitStatus (select 3). Nothing passes select 2.
roles.discriminator: The only threshold test. 0x192f2 compares an input with the logged extreme instead.
roles.cm848_counterpart: cm848_isEngineProtectionInputPastThreshold @ 0x507ebc, counterpart. Same role and callers, but CM848 has a select 1 (maximum pointer), a switch rule with 0x10 active-high and 0x20 active-low, an unwired-switch case for the last record, and signed compares.

roles.role: Dispatcher task 0. It walks the nine channels (configuration records 36 bytes from 0x807032, state records 46 bytes from 0x80d0dc; the bound is tested before the first pass). While a channel's errors are allowed (state +0x16) it updates two over-limit durations. The fueling duration (state +6, configuration flags 0x101) and the engine speed duration (state +8, flags 0x402) each count up by one, saturating at 0xffff, while 0x18968(configuration, state, 0 or 1, 0) reports the input past its threshold; otherwise they are set to 0. While the errors are not allowed, both are cleared.

roles.role: Power-up restart examination, called once from mc68k_applicationMain (0x28738), right after 0x1873e. It needs several gates: engine protection, shutdown and restart all enabled (0x803c98 bits 0x10 / 0x1 / 0x20); a recorded shutdown channel (engine_protection_active_fault_index 0x8058ce != 0xff and != 3, oil pressure); engine_protection_consecutive_shutdown_count (0x8058d0) >= 0x807f3c (EPSOMXLM, the maximum shutdowns before restart is refused); and that channel's shutdown and restart enable bits set (table bits 114 + 4n and 115 + 4n at 0x803c94). Then, for configuration flag 0x1 or 0x2, if 0x18968(configuration, state, 0 or 1, 0) finds the input still past its threshold, it sets the channel's precrank error (state +0x18) and 0x80d28a (e2m 10B1 +10 EPPKSO, 'EPF shutdown engine command from restart examine before cranking'). processDiagnosticLimitStatus ORs 0x80d28a into the shutdown command and the approaching flag.

With flag 0x2 it writes history +6 (engine speed restart severity): 0 or 0x100, from 0x18968(c, s, 1, 0). Its only caller is 0x18cb6.

It acts only for channel 3, which is oil pressure: 0x1873e points that channel's input at oil_pressure_sensor_state.filtered_value, and the e2m mnemonics are EPRYO2SO / EPRYO2SQ (O2 = oil pressure). Otherwise both keep their values. processDiagnosticLimitStatus ORs them into engine_protection_shutdown_approaching_flag (0x19234) and engine_shutdown_command_flag (0x1924a). roles.role: Closes a channel's fault log entry for the fueling fault (0) or the engine speed fault (1). The condition is: the fault bit (configuration +0x1a / +0x1c) is set in 0x806000 and clear in 0x806040. It then clears the 0x806000 bit (interrupts masked). If the log flag (history +0x16 / +0x1a) is set, it also clears the flag, writes the entry's duration (key_on_hour_meter low word - occurrence time) and advances the log index (history +0x18 / +0x1c) modulo 5. Five calls, all from 0x1952c.
roles.discriminator: The only function that clears an engine protection fault bit and advances a log index.
roles.cm848_counterpart: cm848_closeEngineProtectionFaultLogEntry @ 0x5090fc, counterpart. CM848's condition is the fault_registered bit, it clears both the detected and registered bits, and it copies the entry into the channel state.

roles.role: Dispatcher task 3, after the derate engine speed limit. It walks the nine channels through the current-record pointers 0x800622 / 0x800626 / 0x80062a. First it arms the errors-allowed flag (state +0x16). The flag is set at once when configuration +0x16 (start monitor engine speed) and +0x18 (start monitor time) are both 0. Otherwise, engine_rpm_primary above the start speed starts the timer (running flag +0x24), and the flag is set when the timer (+0x22) reaches the start time. Engine speed 0 clears all three. While errors are allowed, a fueling or engine speed fault is active when the precrank error (+0x18) is set, or when the severity index (history +0 / +2) or the shutdown time count (state +0x1a / +0x1c) is nonzero. An active fault adds 1 to its elapsed time (history +0xE / +0x12) and calls 0x19332; an inactive one calls 0x19436. Configuration flag 0x1000 merges both faults into the fueling log. With flags 0xc it records the input extremity (history +8) and its time (history +0xA, key_on_hour_meter). While errors are not allowed it closes both entries.
roles.discriminator: The only writer of the errors-allowed state, the elapsed times and the input extremity.
roles.cm848_counterpart: cm848_logEngineProtectionChannelFaults @ 0x509278, counterpart. Same steps (arming, the 0x1000 merge, the 0xc extremity), but CM848 reads engine_speed_state.filtered_engine_speed instead of engine_rpm_primary, uses its signed helpers, and walks its single channel.

roles.role: Not engine protection. It is the user fueling state selection, run every 20 ms by cm550_runEvery4FramesTaskSetPhase1 (0x1b578). It saves the previous user_fueling_state (0x80ded4, e2m 1050 +2 FSDSFLST), sets it to FUELING_STATE_NOT_SELECTED, then runs the selectors in priority order. Each one claims the state only while it is still NOT_SELECTED: 0xd18a all speed governor application (30), 0x34540 TSC1 torque control, 0xd1a4(previous) TSC1 speed control, 0x34564 user commanded fueling, cm550_selectPedalFaultMode(previous), cm550_selectVariableSpeedGovernorMode(previous), and 0x1c630, which sets the default FUELING_STATE_DUAL_AXIS_FUEL_DEMAND_TABLE.

It loads engine_operating_mode (CM848's FSDSFLST) with lha, clears it, then calls the same seven selectors in the same order, passing the previous state to the 3rd, 5th and 6th (0xfb28, 0x42894, 0x503074, 0x428d4, 0x50daac, 0x10110, 0x1e810). It runs from the same 20 ms task set (cm848_runEvery4FramesTaskSetPhase1). One shared unprefixed name for both rows.

roles.role: Not engine protection. It computes the altitude derate fuel limit and is the only call of cm550_runEvery10FramesTaskSetPhase7 (50 ms). It acts while algorithm_enable_flags_1_cal.altitude_derate_enable (0x803c96 & 0x20) is set and engine_state is RUNNING. If system error bit 18 or 19 (status word 1, bits 2 / 3) is active and enabled in fault_processing_enable_flags, altitude_derate_fuel_limit (0x80a922) gets the default fueling 0x807abc (10A0 +2 ATAAPRDF) above engine speed 0x807aba (ATENESTR), else fuel_demand_maximum. Bits 18 / 19 are the ambient air pressure sensor's high / low error fault numbers (ambient_air_pressure_sensor_config bytes +20 / +21 in the RAM dump). Without those faults the limit is the 2D lookup (record 0x8000da) of engine_rpm_primary x ambient air pressure 0x80a3ba. When disabled or not running, the limit is fuel_demand_maximum. It builds no histogram and no statistics.
roles.discriminator: The only writer of altitude_derate_fuel_limit, which applyAltitudeDerateFuelLimit (0xc742) folds into the fuel limit chain with state 15.

roles.role: Not boost protection. It is a start-up reset of the cruise control and vehicle speed outputs of e2m block 117D, called once from mc68k_applicationMain (0x28786). It clears CRSS cruise_control_active_flag (0x80a9c4), CRRF the cruise control reference speed (0x80a9c6), VSFTAVVS the filtered road speed (0x80a9d0), GRFTGRRA the filtered gear ratio (0x80a9d2) and GROGSS the out-of-gear indicator (0x80a9d4). It sets ZVLMES engine_speed_limit_source_2 (0x80a9d6) to the maximum rated engine speed (0x803f40).

roles.role: TABLE. The nine 36-byte engine protection channel configuration records (e2m blocks 10B7 and 112B-1132, channel order 0 coolant level, 1 coolant temperature, 2 intake manifold temperature, 3 oil pressure, 4 water in fuel, 5 boost pressure, 6 engine sync fuel pressure, 7 fuel temperature, 8 ambient air pressure). The code reaches them only through the base 0x807032 (8 references: 0x18756 0x18a2c 0x18b38 0x18ce8 0x18e12 0x19020 0x19544 0x19708) or as channel x 0x24 (0x18b26). The table ends at 0x807176. Every field is a word, each proven by an access: +0 configuration_flags (masks 0x1 0x2 0x4 0x8 0x10 0x30 0x40 0x100 0x200 0x400 0x800 0x1000; reads at 0x18978 0x18a46 0x1905a 0x19560); +2 fueling_derate_start_duration (0x186ca); +4 engine_speed_derate_start_duration (0x186dc); +6 fueling_ramp_rate (0x186ce); +8 engine_speed_ramp_rate (0x186e0); +0xA fueling_minimum_threshold, +0xC fueling_maximum_threshold, +0xE engine_speed_lower_limit_threshold (addresses stored into the state pointers by 0x1873e, read through them); +0x10 fueling_shutdown_duration_threshold (0x189ca 0x190da); +0x12 engine_speed_shutdown_duration_threshold (0x189ee 0x19184); +0x14 shutdown_delay (0x18fbc 0x18fc4); +0x16 start_monitor_engine_speed (0x19564 0x1957e); +0x18 start_monitor_time (0x1956c 0x195be); +0x1A fueling_fault_index (0x19352); +0x1C engine_speed_fault_index (0x19372); +0x1E shutdown_warning_time (0x18df0 0x19144); +0x20 fueling_shutdown_severity_threshold (0x189d6); +0x22 engine_speed_shutdown_severity_threshold (0x189fa). The record is outside the EEPROM image, so no _cal.
roles.discriminator: Proposed type cm550_engine_protection_channel_configuration_t[9], with CM848's field names. CM550 needs its own type: all its compares are unsigned, so the fields are word, while CM848 types the thresholds short. The channel's enable bits are not in the record: they are algorithm enable table bits 112 + 4n + (0 fueling limiting, 1 rpm limiting, 2 shutdown, 3 restart) at 0x803c94, used by the fuel loop (moveq #112), the speed loop (#113), the shutdown loop (#114) and the restart checks (+2 / +3). Those bits are words 7 and 8 (already typed bitfields) and word 9 bits 0-3. Typing the table replaces the flat rows inside it (0x807032 engine_protection_config_table_base and the 0x807034-0x807174 rows).

roles.role: TABLE. The nine 30-byte engine protection channel history records (e2m blocks 10B2 and 1140-1147). They sit in the flash parameter block RAM copy 0x804f96-0x806549, which cm550_loadParameterBlock1FromFlash loads and the power-down saver writes back. That makes them flash-backed, not part of the EEPROM image, so no _cal. The code reaches them through the base 0x8057c0 (5 references), the current-record pointer 0x80062a, and two direct references: 0x8057c2 (column base at 0x190a0) and 0x80581a (0x19880). Fields, each proven by an access: +0 fueling_severity_index (0x186c4 0x197fa); +2 engine_speed_severity_index (0x186d4 0x18ed4); +4 fueling_restart_severity_index (0x18c4c 0x197c6); +6 engine_speed_restart_severity_index (0x18ca0 0x18ea0); +8 input_extremity (0x19694 0x196a8) (all words); +0xA input_extremity_time dword (0x196ae move.l); +0xE fueling_fault_elapsed_time dword (0x19622 addq.l); +0x12 engine_speed_fault_elapsed_time dword (0x19664 addq.l); +0x16 fueling_fault_log_flag, +0x18 fueling_fault_log_index, +0x1A engine_speed_fault_log_flag, +0x1C engine_speed_fault_log_index (words; 0x1934c-0x19524).

roles.role: Channel 0 (coolant level) history +2, the engine speed severity index (e2m 10B2 +2 EPCVRPIX 'severity index for EPF coolant level fault', 0-1.0 = 0-0x100). cm550_calculateFaultDerateEngineSpeedLimit writes it at 0x18ed4 as max(rampEngineProtectionSeverityIndex(..., 1), history +6). verdicts.final_comment: Sets altitude_derate_fuel_limit (e2m ATFLLM), which applyAltitudeDerateFuelLimit folds into the fuel limit chains. It is fuel_demand_maximum (no derate) unless algorithm_enable_flags_1_cal.altitude_derate_enable is set and engine_state is RUNNING. With either ambient air pressure sensor fault active (faults 18 / 19, the sensor's high / low error: fault word 1 bits 2 / 3 of 0x806002 with their processing enables), it is default_fueling_to_be_used_by_altitude_derate_if_ambient_air_p_0_100 above engine_speed_above_which_derating_will_occur_when_ambient_air_0_8000, else no derate. Otherwise it is the 2D lookup altitude_derate_fuel_limit_lookup of engine_rpm_primary and ambient_air_pressure_sensor_state.filtered_value. It is the only call of cm550_runEvery10FramesTaskSetPhase7. CM848's counterpart blends cool and hot ambient air grids by temperature and handles air handling faults (was cm550_rpmHistogramAndProtectionStatisticsAccumulator).

verdicts.final_comment: The round-robin task of cm550_runEngineProtectionScheduler (CM848's engine_protection_task_index): 0 the over-limit durations, 1 the restart severity, 2 the fault derate fuel limit, 3 the engine speed limit and the fault logs, 4 the shutdown. It advances once per call while engine protection is enabled (it holds while EPEN is clear), wraps after 4 and is cleared by cm550_initializeEngineProtection. Type ENGINE_PROTECTION_TASK (the unused enum PROTECTION_STATE, renamed), or word if the enum is not applied.
